input.prompt: Flat vector illustration for a website hero, in a clean modern corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, subtle grain texture on the large background blob, and simple geometric characters. Scene: a smiling operations manager in a mustard-yellow sweater and a consultant in a periwinkle shirt stand either side of a large floating rounded tablet screen that shows a cost-estimate dashboard made only of abstract elements: a pie chart, three horizontal bars of different lengths, and a rising line chart with a green upward arrow. On the left, a stack of scanned paper invoices and a folder with a small magnifying glass, being read by a small friendly rounded software robot in white and periwinkle blue. On the right, a neat stack of coins and a simple calculator with blank keys, and a balance scale with a document on one side and coins on the other. A yellow lightbulb with sparkles and two pale yellow gears float in the background sky. Background: one large soft light-blue organic blob on a pure white background with a few flat pale clouds; no ground line, objects float within the blob. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, soft green #3BB273, dark navy line accents #1F2A44, white. Airy, balanced composition, wide 16:9 framing, clean white space around the blob. Absolutely no text of any kind: no numbers, no currency symbols, no labels on charts, calculator keys or documents; every screen and paper shows only abstract lines, bars and blocks.
